name: lotflow-ai
description: LotFlow AI: turn what your dealership sees and says into real-time action.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:memory: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev:memory --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
